subject.title: Sessions panel: sort by last meaningful activity, not just last message

question: Which activity taxonomy and projection strategy should the Sessions panel use for ordering rows without letting heartbeat/internal traffic rewrite or displace conversation sessions?
rationale: The implementation would affect gateway list paging, Control UI sorting, event payload semantics, and subagent rollup behavior, and the issue discussion identifies competing storage versus read-time approaches.

options.title: Derive activity on read
options.body: Compute a bounded recent-events projection for list rows and sort/filter by that projection without rewriting parent rows for every child event.

options.title: Persist explicit fields
options.body: Add stored activity timestamps and tested rollup writes, accepting migration/write-load work as part of the feature.

options.title: Keep updatedAt sorting
options.body: Leave the current updatedAt-based ordering and address only previews or labels in narrower related UX items.

recommendation.title: Derive activity on read
recommendation.body: Compute a bounded recent-events projection for list rows and sort/filter by that projection without rewriting parent rows for every child event.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and PR history make steipete the strongest routing candidate for the Control UI/gateway session list decision.
